speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Migrans (Lyme Disease). The combination of recent camping in Minnesota, a self-resolving mono-articular knee effusion, and acute onset of fever, chills, and wrist pain strongly suggests disseminated Lyme disease, likely involving the knee (arthritis) and potentially the wrist (tenosynovitis or adjacent erythema migrans). The previous suggestion of iron deficiency anemia is incorrect given your acute systemic inflammatory signs.
